Name: Neighbourhood/Omgivning
Basic relationship:
B_r([a]) = {[x] \in \\R^n: |[x]-[a]|<r}

n=1: open interval (a-r, a+r)
n=2: open disk
n=3: open ball

Name:
Open/closed set
Öppen/Sluten mängd
Basic relationship:
Open interval, closed interval -> Open set, closed set
Öppen interval, sluten intervall -> Öppen mängd, sluten mängd

S is open in \\R^n if every point of S has neighbourhood contained in S (sets defined by strict inequalities < or > e.g. x+y+z>2)

Name: Complement/Komplement, $math{S^c}
Basic relationship:
Set of all points in \\R^n that does not belong to S
Complement to open set -> closed set

Name: Boundary point/Randpunkter
Basic relationship:
Every neighbourhood of P contains both points in S and points in S^c
Boundary bdry(S) = set of all boundary points in S
Varje omgivning innehåller inre och yttre punkter

Interior point/Inre punkt: int(S), Inuti mängden (omgivning som ligger innanför mängden
Exterior point/Yttre punkt: ext(S), Utifrån mängden (omgivning som ligger utanför mängden)
Both are open sets
